description: This is an entry point file for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then mounts the React application onto the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render a React application into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React application within the created root.
